name: Scandinavian Heritage (former Oscar Jacobson Group)
via: Mellby Gård lists Scandinavian Heritage in its group company overview and marks its share as 90% or more
note: Holding group for the Oscar Jacobson and Filippa K fashion brands, head office Borås, formed in 2025 from the Oscar Jacobson Group (oscarjacobson.com history). Listed under Consumer Goods in Mellby Gård's company overview with a 90% share figure and the footnote 'In Companies with 90%, Mellby Gårds share is >90%' (mellby-gaard.se, opened 2026-10-03).
